name: @advance/contracts-ts
description: TypeScript bindings for the explorador advance Soroban contracts (teurc/, cpcv_note/, advance_pool/), generated from the built wasm by `stellar contract bindings typescript` during `pnpm deploy:testnet` (or `pnpm deploy:testnet --skip-build --bindings-only`). Contract ids live in deployments/testnet.json. Not part of the app build: they target @stellar/stellar-sdk 16 while the app uses its own decoders on SDK 17.
